title: Butterfly 01
name: butterfly-01
arc:
The dancehall butterfly: knees open and close with weight centred. The figure stays over both feet, a brief lift of the character-left foot at frame 6, arms low at the waist with elbows bent.

The drawn content is the knees. Keep them visibly opening and closing between keys; the upper body stays quiet. Pingpong: frames 0 and 17 are grounded turnarounds.
